title: EU Unveils $1 Billion 'Team Gaza Initiative' for War Recovery
detail: The European Commission announced a $1 billion aid and reconstruction fund, the 'Team Gaza Initiative,' at a donor meeting in Brussels, aimed at helping Gaza recover from more than two years of war. The fund will support restoring water and sanitation infrastructure, removing rubble, and re-establishing health infrastructure. It comes against a backdrop of UN/EU estimates that Gaza needs more than $71 billion over the next decade for full recovery, with $26.3 billion required in the first 18 months alone.

title: Israeli Forces Kill Palestinian Man Near Separation Barrier at Bir Nabala
detail: Israeli forces shot and killed a young Palestinian man (reported variously as 19 or 20 years old) near the separation barrier in Bir Nabala, north of Jerusalem, after he allegedly attempted to cross into East Jerusalem in search of work. Troops opened fire, striking him in the abdomen; he was pronounced dead after ambulance crews arrived. The Israeli military did not immediately comment. The area near the barrier has seen repeated shootings of Palestinians attempting to cross.
